landing.title: Votain
landing.hero_desc: Participate in democratic processes with full privacy. Votain uses cryptographic proofs to ensure your vote counts without revealing your identity.

onboarding.what_desc: Vote safely and secretly from any device. No one will ever know what you chose.
onboarding.privacy_desc: We use World ID to ensure you are a real person. We never store your data.
onboarding.coercion_desc: If someone forces you to vote, you can do it again in secret later. Only the last one counts.
onboarding.free_desc: You don't need to pay anything or understand crypto. The organizer handles everything.

verify.title: Verify your Identity
verify.description: We use World ID to ensure one vote per person. Your biometric data never leaves your device and is never shared with us.
verify.mobile_return_hint: After verifying in the app, come back to this tab
verify.qr_desc: Open the World ID app and scan this code to verify your identity.
verify.error_backend: Verification failed on our end. Please try again.
verify.error_generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

voting_type.absolute_majority_desc: Winner needs more than 50% of votes cast
voting_type.two_thirds_desc: Yes/No — approved with at least 2/3 of votes
voting_type.witness_threshold_desc: Yes/No — approved with at least N confirmations

common.integration_pending: This feature will be connected in the integration phase.

discover.title: Elections
discover.subtitle: Browse open and past elections
discover.empty_desc: Try a different search or clear your filters.

election.auth_cta: Verify your identity to participate in this election.
election.gas_low_banner: Your gas balance is low. Top up to vote.
election.cta_tallying: Voting has ended. Results are being tallied.
election.cta_voided: This election was voided. No results will be published.
election.cta_not_enrolled: Enrollment closed before you joined, so you cannot vote in this election.
election.cta_pending_vote: Enrollment is closed. Voting hasn't started yet.

how.title: How Votain works
how.subtitle: End-to-end verifiable voting, anonymous and coercion-resistant — built on open standards.
how.step1_desc: Use World ID to prove you're a unique human. No personal data is stored or shared.
how.step2_desc: Your vote is encrypted on your device. A zero-knowledge proof ensures it's counted without revealing your choice.
how.step3_desc: If coerced, you can vote again later. Only your last vote counts, so your true choice is always safe.
how.step4_desc: Results are published on IPFS and the blockchain. Anyone can audit the tally without breaking anonymity.

verify_receipt.title: Verify your vote
verify_receipt.subtitle: Enter your reference number or nullifier to confirm your vote was recorded.
verify_receipt.hint: Your reference number was shown after you voted.
verify_receipt.not_found_desc: No matching vote was found. Check your reference number and try again.

voter_elections.title: My Elections
voter_elections.subtitle: Elections you are enrolled in
voter_elections.empty: You haven't enrolled in any elections yet.

confirmation.title: Vote cast!
confirmation.desc: Your vote has been recorded on the blockchain. Use your reference number to verify it anytime.

change_vote.title: Change your vote
change_vote.warning: Changing your vote will invalidate your previous choice. Only your final vote counts.
change_vote.modal_desc: You are about to change your vote to {{candidate}}. This action cannot be undone immediately.

history.title: Vote history
history.subtitle: All elections you have participated in
history.empty: You haven't voted in any elections yet.

reverify.title: Recover your voting identity
reverify.desc: Lost every device that could unlock your identity? Verify with World ID again to link a new passkey.
reverify.reason1: I lost the phone or device holding my passkey
reverify.reason2: I deleted my passkey, or cleared my browser data
reverify.reason3: None of my registered devices can unlock my identity any more
reverify.recovered_desc: This device now holds your voting identity. You can vote in elections you had not joined yet.
reverify.cost_elections: You will not be able to rejoin elections you had already enrolled in, even if you never voted in them.
reverify.cost_receipts: Your previous vote receipts stop being retrievable, though those ballots stay valid and counted.
reverify.one_identity_note: One World ID always means one voting identity.

org_auth.title: Organizer Access
org_auth.subtitle: Secure login with passkey and wallet
org_auth.passkey_desc: Create or use an existing passkey to authenticate securely.
org_auth.wallet_desc: Connect your Polygon wallet to sign transactions on behalf of your elections.
org_auth.wrong_network_desc: Please switch to Polygon Amoy to continue.
org_auth.no_wallet_desc: Install MetaMask (or another EVM wallet) to sign as an organizer.
org_auth.no_authenticator: No passkey authenticator on this device
org_auth.no_authenticator_help: Set up a screen lock (Windows Hello PIN, Touch ID, or Android screen lock), or use a phone or security key when prompted.

dashboard.title: Organizer Dashboard
dashboard.subtitle: Manage your elections
dashboard.no_elections: No elections yet. Create your first one.

create.title: Create Election
create.blank_vote_note: A blank vote option is always included automatically.
create.require_orb_desc: Voters must verify with the World ID Orb (highest assurance).
create.quorum_hint: Minimum votes required before results are revealed.
create.deposit_hint: Initial gas to cover voter transaction fees.
create.immutability_warning: Once deployed, the election parameters cannot be changed. Review everything carefully.
create.deploy_confirm_desc: This will deploy a smart contract and deduct {{amount}} {{currency}} from your gas balance.
create.witness_threshold_hint: Minimum Yes votes needed to approve
create.yes_no_note: This voting type always uses a fixed Yes / No ballot.
create.leave_confirm_desc: Your changes will be lost if you leave this page.
create.separate_enrollment_desc: Set your own registration dates, with a deadline that can fall before voting opens.
create.enrollment_until_vote_start: Registration is open from deployment until voting starts.
create.yes_no_hint: There is nothing to configure here: the options are set by the voting rule you chose. Voters will pick one of them.

election_mgmt.close_desc: No more votes will be accepted. This action cannot be undone.
election_mgmt.tally_desc: Your device will decrypt the aggregated result. You can review the counts before publishing them on-chain.
election_mgmt.cancel_desc: All enrolled voters will be notified. This action is irreversible.
election_mgmt.close_enrollment_desc: Voting will start immediately for everyone already enrolled.
election_mgmt.tally_quorum_short: Privacy quorum not met ({{voters}} of {{quorum}}). Void the election instead of publishing.
election_mgmt.tally_key_missing: The decryption key for this election is not on this device. Open Votain on the device you created the election with.

profile.title: Profile
profile.delete_passkey_desc: You will no longer be able to sign in with this passkey.
profile.sign_out_desc: You will be returned to the login screen.
profile.no_passkey: No passkey registered on this device.
profile.wallet_note: Only used to sign transactions. You sign in with your passkey.

errors.not_found_desc: The page you're looking for doesn't exist or has been moved.

demo.banner: Demo data — no contracts deployed. Nothing here is on-chain.

validation.candidates_min: Add at least 2 candidates with a name
validation.fix_previous_steps: Some required fields are missing or invalid. Go back and review the previous steps.

devices.title: My devices
devices.desc: Vote from any of your devices. Every passkey unlocks the same identity, so you always cast one ballot.
devices.last_passkey: Add another device before removing this one
